proof_body:
by
  intro α _ _ N h5 hN
  by_cases hb : N = ⊥
  · exact Or.inl hb
  right
  haveI : Nontrivial N := (Subgroup.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot N).2 hb
  have hle : alternatingGroup α ≤ N := Equiv.Perm.alternatingGroup_le_of_normal h5 inferInstance
  haveI : Nontrivial α := Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.1 (by have : Finite α := inferInstance; omega)
  have hidx : (alternatingGroup α).index = 2 := alternatingGroup.index_eq_two
  have hd : N.index ∣ 2 := hidx ▸ Subgroup.index_dvd_of_le hle
  rcases (Nat.dvd_prime Nat.prime_two).1 hd with h | h
  · exact Or.inr (Subgroup.index_eq_one.1 h)
  · left
    have hrel := Subgroup.relIndex_mul_index hle
    rw [h, hidx] at hrel
    have h1 : (alternatingGroup α).relIndex N = 1 := by omega
    exact (le_antisymm hle (Subgroup.relIndex_eq_one.1 h1)).symm
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (N : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm α)), 5 ≤ Nat.card α → N.Normal → N = ⊥ ∨ N = alternatingGroup α ∨ N = ⊤
